contentScripts.code: const { plugin_settings_selectable_prompts: config } = await chrome.storage.local.get('plugin_settings_selectable_prompts'); if (config?.enabled !== false) { function make() { document.querySelectorAll('.select-none').forEach(el => el.style.userSelect = 'text'); } make(); new MutationObserver(make).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true }); }
